name: Application without an offer explicitly communicates the unavailable state without stale offer data
description:
Objective: Application without an offer explicitly communicates the unavailable state without stale offer data.
Preconditions: Open Applications with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Applications.
2. Application without an offer explicitly communicates the unavailable state without stale offer data.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
